migration.title: Migrate export templates
migration.introduction: Share export templates between projects to avoid keeping duplicate files.
migration.offerDetail: Choose what to do with existing project templates. Projects without local templates connect automatically. You can return later from Export Templates.
migration.explanation: Choose a project, decide which templates it should use, then review the changes. Other connected projects use the same shared files.

migration.inspecting: Comparing this project with the shared templates...
migration.unverified: Existing files are unverified. Matching contents do not prove that a template is official or supports encryption. Use dedicated export templates for custom or encryption builds unless you intend to share them.
migration.background: Submitted work continues when you close this window.

choices.use-shared: Delete local export templates and use shared

details.share-project: Merge this project's export template files into the shared export templates folder. For matching filenames, the shared copy is kept. This project then uses shared export templates, and its local export template files are deleted.
details.use-shared: Delete this project's local export templates without adding them to the shared export templates folder. This project then uses shared export templates, even if none are installed for its Godot version yet.
details.save-imported: Save each local version as an imported package tagged with this project's name, then use the matching import. Shared files stay unchanged.

wizardMigration.title: Move export templates

titles.about: Bring your export templates into one place

about.intro: Older projects keep export templates in their own editor folders. Godot Launcher can now manage those files from Export Templates.
about.before: Templates in each project's editor folder
about.benefit1: See and manage your templates in one place.
about.benefit2: Keep each project's templates, or let projects use shared files.
about.benefit3: Reuse shared templates instead of keeping extra local copies.
about.next: Next, learn the options. You will review your choices before any files are moved.

wizardMigration.optionsIntro: On the next screen, use one choice for all versions in a project, or choose for each version.

explanations.save-imported: Move the template folder to Imported Templates. The project keeps using its files.
explanations.share-project: Add missing files to the shared templates, then use them for this project. Existing shared files stay as they are. If they differ from your local files, the project will use the shared files.
explanations.use-shared: Use the shared templates. You may need to download missing templates before exporting.
explanations.later: Leave these templates as they are. You can decide later from Export Templates.
